[[File:Cave crawler icon.png|left]]
'''Cave crawlers''' are [[Slayer]] monsters that require level 10 Slayer to kill. They drop a variety of [[Herblore]] related items and seeds. They are poisonous and have a fast healing rate (approximately 10 life points per second). 

In the quest [[Fur 'n Seek]], a [[cave crawler skin]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]].

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Cave crawlers poison fairly often with their ranged attacks so it is advised to bring [[antipoison]] when fighting them, or prevent being poisoned (for some time) using a [[super antipoison]], the [[anti-poison totem]], or using the Oo'glog [[thermal bath]] prior to engaging in combat. Their poison is not much of a threat at higher levels, and can be offset with good food or healing abilities. However, lower level players are suggested to bring at least one method of poison mitigation, as it can be deadly if not paid attention to. Due to their high accuracy, complete mitigation of damage at lower levels is unlikely.

Level 59 cave crawlers drop all of the required components for many potions such as [[prayer potion]] ([[Vial of water]], [[Grimy ranarr|ranarr]] and [[snape grass]]) at a fairly regular rate, allowing players to stay in the area for longer. They also drop all the ingredients for both antipoison and super antipoison which is very handy considering the accuracy of their attacks, and therefore the frequency at which they cause poison and wear away anti-poison timers. Some other useful potions made from their drops are [[restore potion]]s, [[strength potion]], [[super strength]], [[super attack]], [[prayer potion]] and [[super defence potion]].

==Trivia==
* Cave crawlers are a popular delicacy amongst the [[Dorgeshuun]] cave goblins, who cut them into [[fillets]] and serve them on a large platter.
